faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes G63 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: The 2012-2018 W463-generation G63 AMG uses the M157 - a 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8. This is a different engine from both the earlier M156 naturally-aspirated V8 and the newer M177 4.0-litre V8 fitted to the 2018-present G63 AMG.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes G63 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500 for the M157. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my G63 AMG?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M157 or the M177 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M157 G63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace valve seals, timing chains, coolant components and bearings as standard on every M157 rebuild - the same pattern confirmed across the AMG V8 family.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used G63 AMG engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my G63 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a G63 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most G63 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
